Retain bounded repairs and author decisions rather than treating publication as production qualification.

The two branches merge without source-level conflicts; only the generated implementation identity required recomputation. Tests/hooks/builds/Provider calls/migration/deployment for this publication are NOT_RUN by user request. Original worktrees remain untouched. GitHub Actions remain disabled.

The separate creative-validation-resources branch ad1c229d4b17db45fa14c73dcc6569e8655c82c9 is pushed but not included: its independent migrations 0157–0159 and Planning/World recovery contracts conflict with this branch. The preserved integration attempt has 17 conflicted files; a coordinated integration is required before that branch can safely merge.
